1.mascotDialogue: It is insertion sort, granted permission to take large steps first. Shrink the gap sufficiently, and it collapses into ordinary insertion sort for the final, finest pass.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2's gap begins at n over 2 and halves with every outer pass. Lines 6 through 8 are simply insertion sort's inner loop, comparing arr[j] to arr[j minus gap] instead of arr[j minus 1].

3.mascotDialogue: Watch these first comparisons skip across three positions at once — a gap of 3, making long-distance corrections before the finer gap-of-1 pass even begins.

4.mascotDialogue: A rather subtle kind of bug, this — the output is correct, but the algorithm has quietly stopped being the algorithm it claims to be. Not every bug crashes; some simply discard the entire reason you chose this approach.
